prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1082; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed initial first notice of loss. Insured reports vehicle struck by oncoming sedan during left turn at intersection. Police report requested. Insured statement recorded and consistent with description. No further action until report received.

Entry 2: Police report received. Responding officer cites the other driver for failure to yield on a permissive left turn. Scene photos and two witness statements added to file. Liability appears clear in favor of our insured, pending review of traffic signal timing data.

Entry 3: Claimant's counsel has entered representation and requested that all communications be routed through their office. Letter of representation logged. Medical authorization requested. Claimant reports neck pain and whiplash symptoms, treating at urgent care followed by physical therapy referral. Reserve set for bodily injury based on early treatment records.

Entry 4: Received medical records from urgent care and initial physical therapy evaluation. Diagnosis consistent with cervical strain. Claimant's counsel submitted a demand package requesting policy limits. Demand under review. Requested itemized medical bills and wage loss documentation. Evaluation of settlement value in progress, with supervisor notified of the demand.

Entry 5: Counsel responded to request for updated records and indicated treatment is ongoing. Follow-up with treating provider scheduled through counsel's office. Recommended reserve review at next file audit. File remains open pending completion of medical review and response to demand.
